cves.title: Android Framework Privilege Escalation (Active Exploitation)
cves.advice: Install the November 2024 or newer Android Security Patch immediately.

cves.title: Android Framework Elevation of Privilege
cves.advice: Update Android system security patch to 2024-09-05 or newer.

cves.title: Framework Local Escalation of Privilege
cves.advice: Install the April 2025 or newer Android Security Bulletin update.

cves.title: System Remote Code Execution over Bluetooth/Media
cves.advice: Update to the September 2025 or later security patch level.

cves.title: Skia Integer Overflow Sandbox Escape
cves.advice: Update Android OS and Android System WebView via your app store.
